name: Nevermined
tagline: Agentic payments infra + AI Services Catalog: agents buy 160 paid services inside a spend mandate, via MCP
status_notes: Active; Oct 15, 2026 update added card-funded Subscription credits, Catalog Readiness scoring, MPP payment channels. Also sells merchant/PSP infrastructure. o11 comparison post (vendor content) treats it as a direct alternative.
backers: ~$4M round (Jan 2025) led by Generative Ventures with Polymorphic Capital, NEAR, Halo Capital, Factor Capital, Lyrik Ventures, Arca; reported $7M total. Founders Don Gossen & Aitor Argomaniz (ex-Ocean Protocol)

pricing.platform_fee: 2% buyer fee on external services (all rails); $0 when buying from Nevermined merchants; merchants pay 1% stablecoin / 2% card
pricing.subscription: Free (2,000 catalog credits); Catalog $20/mo = 20,000 credits; $10 packs; orgs $50/$250/$500 mo
pricing.notes: Free tier gives 2,000 credits (USD value of a credit not stated, so free_credit_usd left null).

spend_controls.notes: Spend mandate/delegation = payment method + amount + expiry + number of purchases; revoke in one action; groups with own caps (Premium); per-delivery-status spend breakdown; prepaid credits cannot exceed balance; separate sandbox keys.

setup_steps_to_first_call: Create account and API key (live: prefix)
Use free credits/subscribe, or enroll card and create a delegation (spend mandate)
Ask agent for a capability; catalog picks and pays a service
strengths: Mandates with amount + expiry + purchase-count and one-click revoke
Readiness score + live health per service
ISO 27001 / SOC 2 Type II / PCI SAQ-D claims
weaknesses: Little public info on BYO accounts, idempotency, failed-call refunds

sources.claim: 160 vetted paid services; MCP URL; 2,000 free credits; $20/mo 20,000 credits
Pricing tiers; 2% buyer fee; merchant 1-2%; groups with spending caps; certifications; llms.txt link
Oct 15 2026 update: subscription, readiness, MPP channels, spend breakdown
Delegation = payment method + spend mandate; sandbox/live keys; revoke delegation
$4M round led by Generative Ventures; founders
